title: How war with US is reshaping nuclear doctrine of post-Khamenei Iran
gist: The war with the US has exposed the limits of Iran's deterrence and Khamenei's death removed the religious authority behind its nuclear-weapons prohibition; Iran's Assembly of Experts has now called NPT withdrawal and stronger deterrence an 'unavoidable necessity'.

insights.claim: The war with the US has exposed the limits of Tehran's deterrence strategy, creating room to challenge Iran's official rejection of nuclear weapons.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: Raises the probability of Iranian weaponization, a major tail risk for regional and oil markets.
insights.quote: The war with the US has exposed the limits of Tehran's deterrence strategy

insights.claim: The death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei removed the religious authority most closely associated with Iran's prohibition on nuclear arms.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: The fatwa-based constraint on weaponization has weakened.
insights.quote: removed the religious authority most closely associated with Iran's prohibition on nuclear arms

insights.claim: Iran's Assembly of Experts called for a review of defense doctrine and consideration of withdrawing from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, the clearest indication yet of a strategic shift.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: NPT exit would likely trigger renewed US/Israeli strikes; watch Majlis and Foreign Ministry follow-through.
insights.locator: The new context is creating room

insights.claim: The Assembly framed NPT withdrawal and stronger deterrence as an 'unavoidable necessity' and 'national demand', an obligation rather than one possible response to pressure.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: Framing as obligation signals institutional momentum, not mere bargaining.

insights.claim: The Assembly asked the Foreign Ministry to communicate Tehran's position to neighboring countries and support the 'path of resistance'.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: Gulf neighbors will be lobbied directly; watch their diplomatic responses.
